entry.title: October 15, 2026 — Named, Argon2id, icon set
entry.summary: The plugin is now called Interleaf everywhere. New sealed notes derive keys with Argon2id instead of PBKDF2. Full favicon and app-icon set. 255 unit tests passing.
entry.content:
Named. The plugin is now called Interleaf everywhere — docs, UI strings, self-identification on the wire, and the plugin id, which is now interleaf.

Argon2id. New sealed notes derive keys with Argon2id instead of PBKDF2. Older notes still open exactly as before.

Icons. Full favicon and app-icon set across the site.

255 unit tests passing.

entry.title: October 14, 2026 — interleaf.dev live, spec published
entry.summary: interleaf.dev is live. OM-1 and OM-2 protocol spec published. License: BUSL-1.1 converting to GPL v3. info@interleaf.dev live — DKIM signed, DMARC p=reject, MTA-STS.
entry.content:
interleaf.dev is live. Registered and shipped the same day.

Spec published — the OM-1 and OM-2 protocol documents, readable at /spec.md.

License — Business Source License 1.1, converting to GPL v3.

Mail. info@interleaf.dev is live — DKIM signed, DMARC p=reject, MTA-STS.
